title: It’s Tappy
description: The stranger’s sleepy voice becomes familiar. Eric discovers who has been under the tarpaulin.
transcript: The worm gives you a sleepy look.
You recognise the voice. It’s Tappy.
He finally wriggles free of the tarpaulin and looks back towards the trail.
I was wondering when you were going to wake me up.
He looks at you for a moment.
And before you ask… no, I don't remember much either.
But I remember there was music.
